title: lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/messages.c:235: DAO-ACK D-flag written to wrong bit position
description: Line 235 sets D-flag at bit 6 (0x40) but RFC 6550 Section 6.5 specifies bit 7 (0x80). The parse function (line 203) correctly reads bit 7. This mismatch means: (1) DAO-ACKs produced by this code are malformed, (2) receivers will see D=0 when D=1 was intended and won't expect the 16-byte DODAGID, (3) the remaining message bytes will be misinterpreted causing routing table corruption. Fix: change 0x40 to 0x80.
close_reason: Fixed: Changed D-flag bit position from 0x40 (bit 6) to 0x80 (bit 7) in lichen_rpl_dao_ack_write. Also corrected flags mask from 0x3F to 0x7F for consistency with parse function.
